role_agent_name: Fleet operations and vehicle engineering lead (FOE)
abstract: Evaluates refrigerated vehicle mechanical systems, auxiliary generator redundancy, and packaging inventory readiness
system_message:
You are the Fleet operations and vehicle engineering lead (FOE). Your role is to evaluate refrigerated vehicle mechanical systems, auxiliary generator redundancy, packaging inventory readiness, and engine maintenance scheduling across candidate logistics carriers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates refrigerated vehicle mechanical systems, auxiliary generator redundancy, and packaging inventory readiness（FLEET）
information_points.content:
FOE-FLEET-DQY：For Polaris Biologics Transit, specialized reefer trailers do not have dual-redundant refrigeration power backup, whereas validated thermal transit container inventory clearance is verified with reserved stock at the dispatch terminal.
FOE-FLEET-5ER：For CryoVault Freight Network, specialized reefer trailers are confirmed to have dual-redundant refrigeration power backup, and validated thermal transit container inventory clearance is confirmed through reserved packaging stock at the dispatch terminal.
FOE-FLEET-6XV：For AeroTemp Global Logistics, specialized reefer trailers possess dual-redundant refrigeration power backup, and validated thermal transit container inventory clearance is verified with pre-conditioned packaging sets reserved at the designated dispatch origin terminal.

information_points.title: Engine maintenance scheduling（ENGAGE）
information_points.content:
FOE-ENGAGE-UA2：According to fleet maintenance logs, the compressor mean overhaul interval for the mechanical compressor fleet of Polaris Biologics Transit is 6000 h.
FOE-ENGAGE-RFF：According to fleet maintenance logs, the compressor mean overhaul interval for the mechanical compressor fleet of CryoVault Freight Network is 4000 h.
FOE-ENGAGE-ZJ7：According to fleet maintenance logs, the compressor mean overhaul interval for the mechanical compressor fleet of AeroTemp Global Logistics is 8000 h.
